ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (34) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Благо» (blago, 'the good') and «положить жизнь в» (polozhit' zhizn' v, 'to place one's life in'), repeated by Epictetus and Pascal, are kept constant; «духовное совершенствование» (dukhovnoe sovershenstvovanie) is 'spiritual perfecting'. Attributions follow the print («Джон Рёскин», Dzhon Ryoskin, 'John Ruskin'; Lichtenberg with its final period).
Source observation: [21] «истинно благо» (istinno blago, 'truly good') reads like a slip for «истинное благо» (istinnoe blago, 'the true good'); translated as 'the true good'.
